lede: The most substantive government action this week is a public hearing Monday before Town Council sitting as the Liquor Licensing Authority, where KOTO Radio's San Miguel Educational Fund is seeking a special event permit for its Live at the Drive concert at 207 N Pine Street on July 30th. Also worth watching: the Gondola Leadership Committee meets Tuesday with what looks like a real action item on background and history alongside a Capital Investment Grant funding review — more than a routine update. The rest of the week's meetings either haven't posted agendas or are work sessions with nothing yet on the table.
